concept_uz: Tungi reys: Toshkentdan Nyu-Yorkka. Malika ekrandagi xaritada yoʻl shimolga egilganini koʻrib, «uchuvchi adashdi!» deb qichqiradi. Bobosi sumkasidan globus va ip chiqaradi: ip taranglansa, oʻzi shimolga buriladi — shardagi eng qisqa yoʻl shu. Adashgan uchuvchi emas, xarita ekan.

facts.claim: Toshkentdan Nyu-Yorkka yoʻl ekrandagi xaritada shimolga katta yoy chizadi
Toshkent va Nyu-York deyarli bir xil kenglikda, taxminan 41° shimolda
Parallel boʻylab (yassi xaritadagi toʻgʻri chiziq) ≈ 12 020 km
Katta doira boʻylab ≈ 10 170 km; yoʻl taxminan 70° kenglikkacha koʻtariladi
Farq 1850 km dan koʻproq — bir necha soatlik parvoz va tonnalab yoqilgʻi
Globus va ipni taranglab tortsa, ip eng qisqa yoʻlni topadi va shimolga bukiladi
Apelsin poʻstini yirtmasdan va choʻzmasdan tekis yoyib boʻlmaydi; har bir xarita nimanidir buzadi

style_line: Cinematic photoreal, night flight cabin lit by soft warm reading lamps and the cool blue glow of a seat-back screen, deep blue night outside the window, 35mm film look, cosy and curious family mood. No text, no letters, no watermark, no airline logos.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 interior of a long-haul airliner economy cabin at night: two seats by an oval window, dark blue night sky and a few stars outside, warm reading lamps, a seat-back screen glowing softly in front of the window seat, tray tables folded. Generic cabin, no logos, no signs, no people.

Vertical 9:16 portrait of an Uzbek girl of about 11, two dark braids, a bright YELLOW hairband, a green hooded sweatshirt, big curious brown eyes, sitting in an airliner window seat at night, lit by a warm reading lamp.

Vertical 9:16 portrait of a kind Uzbek grandfather of about 68, short neat white beard, ROUND WIRE GLASSES, a black-and-white embroidered skullcap (doppi), a grey wool jacket over a white shirt, a small worn brown leather bag on his lap, sitting in an airliner aisle seat at night, gentle smile.

Combine the attached images into one vertical 9:16 shot: the girl in the window seat and her grandfather in the aisle seat beside her. The girl leans forward, pointing at the glowing seat-back screen, which shows a dark-blue flat world map with one bright orange line curving high upward in an arc between two dots. No letters or numbers on the screen. Same faces, same clothes, same light.

Vertical 9:16 close-up of an airliner seat-back screen at night: a flat world map in dark navy blue with pale continents, one glowing orange route line arcing high toward the top of the map between two small white dots, a tiny white airplane icon sitting on the arc. No letters, no numbers, no labels, no logos.

Change the scene: the grandfather now holds a small desk globe on his lap and a spool of RED thread in his other hand, smiling at the girl over his round glasses; the girl turns from the screen to look at the globe, surprised. Same faces, same clothes, same cabin, same light, 9:16.

Change the scene: the grandfather's tray table is down; a folded paper world map is opened flat on it, and his finger runs along a small wooden ruler laid in a straight horizontal line between two pencil dots, one in Central Asia and one on the east coast of North America. The girl watches closely. No letters or words on the map. Same faces, same light, 9:16.

Change the framing: extreme close-up of the small desk globe in the grandfather's hands. A red thread is pulled tight between two small pins, one in Central Asia and one on the east coast of North America; the taut thread bends up toward the north pole, over the top of the world. The girl's finger touches the thread. No letters on the globe. Same light, 9:16.

Change the scene: the girl's tray table is down; she holds a whole orange peel in one piece and presses it flat on the tray, but it splits and tears into ragged petals. Half an orange sits beside it. The grandfather watches, amused. Same faces, same clothes, same light, 9:16.

scenes.prompt: The girl suddenly jumps in her seat and jabs her finger at the glowing seat-back screen, eyes wide; the grandfather opens one sleepy eye. Audio: steady engine hum, a soft cabin chime, the girl's gasp. The girl says loudly in Uzbek with a bright, lively girl's voice of about 11: "Bobo! Qarang, uchuvchi adashib qoldi!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Nyu-York toʻgʻrida-ku, biz esa shimolga ketyapmiz!

scenes.prompt: Slow push-in on the seat-back screen: the tiny airplane icon creeps along the orange arc, climbing toward the top of the map instead of going straight across; the girl's finger enters the frame and traces a straight line beside it. Audio: engine hum, a soft electronic tick. The girl says off-screen in Uzbek with a bright, lively girl's voice of about 11, puzzled: "Nyu-York to'g'rida-ku, biz esa shimolga ketyapmiz!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Adashgan uchuvchi emas, qizim. Bizni xarita adashtiryapti.

scenes.prompt: The grandfather calmly lifts the small desk globe out of his leather bag, sets it on his knees and unwinds a little red thread from the spool, smiling over his round glasses. Audio: zip of the bag, a soft creak, engine hum. He says in Uzbek with a warm, slow, gentle elderly male voice of about 68: "Adashgan uchuvchi emas, qizim. Bizni xarita adashtiryapti." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Xaritada toʻgʻri chiziq — oʻn ikki ming yigirma kilometr.

scenes.prompt: Top-down close shot of the paper map on the tray table: the grandfather's finger slides slowly along the wooden ruler from the dot in Central Asia to the dot in North America. Audio: paper rustle, finger on wood. He says in Uzbek with a warm, slow, gentle elderly male voice of about 68: "Xaritada to'g'ri chiziq — o'n ikki ming yigirma kilometr." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Endi ipni taranglaymiz… U oʻzi shimolga buriladi. Oʻn ming bir yuz yetmish!

scenes.prompt: Extreme close-up of the globe: the red thread, loose at first, is pulled tight between the two pins and visibly swings up over the top of the world toward the north pole; the globe turns slightly. Audio: the thread twangs softly, a gentle rising musical note. The grandfather says in Uzbek with a warm, slow, gentle elderly male voice of about 68: "Endi ipni taranglaymiz... U o'zi shimolga buriladi. O'n ming bir yuz yetmish!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Ming sakkiz yuz ellik kilometr qisqa ekan-da?!
Ha. Bir necha soat va tonnalab yoqilgʻi.

scenes.prompt: Two-shot in the night cabin: the girl's jaw drops, she counts quickly on her fingers and looks up at her grandfather; he nods slowly and taps the window, where the wing tip light blinks over a dark snowy northern land far below. Audio: engine hum, a light blink tick. The girl says in Uzbek with a bright, lively girl's voice of about 11: "Ming sakkiz yuz ellik kilometr qisqa ekan-da?!" Then the grandfather answers in Uzbek with a warm, slow, gentle elderly male voice of about 68: "Ha. Bir necha soat va tonnalab yoqilg'i." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Sharni qogʻozga buzmasdan yoyib boʻlmaydi. Xarita ham shunday.

scenes.prompt: Close shot of the tray table: the girl presses the orange peel flat with both palms and it rips into ragged petals; she looks up in comic dismay while the grandfather chuckles. Audio: a wet tearing sound, a small laugh. The girl says in Uzbek with a bright, lively girl's voice of about 11: "Yirtilib ketdi!" Then the grandfather says in Uzbek with a warm, slow, gentle elderly male voice of about 68: "Sharni qog'ozga buzmasdan yoyib bo'lmaydi. Xarita ham shunday." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Uyingizda globus bormi? Ip bilan sinab koʻring va izohda yozing!

scenes.prompt: The girl holds the small globe with the taut red thread up to the camera, turns it so the thread arcs over the north pole, then looks straight into the lens with a proud grin. Hold on her look at the end. Audio: engine hum, one soft cabin chime. The girl says in Uzbek with a bright, lively girl's voice of about 11, friendly and excited: "Uyingizda globus bormi? Ip bilan sinab ko'ring va izohda yozing!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

post_text_uz: Samolyot nega xaritada egri uchadi? Uchuvchi adashmagan — Yer shar, xarita esa tekis. Toshkentdan Nyu-Yorkka shimol orqali uchish 1850 km dan koʻproq qisqa! Uyda globus va ip bilan sinab koʻring va izohda yozing. #NegaShunday #matematika #globus #Powerty
